samples.question: The picture shows two framed panels. The blue-framed panel on the left is the legend: it has four rows, and each row prints one coloured square beside one small black stroke drawn inside a square area. The four strokes are always these four and no others: a bar (a horizontal stroke across the middle), a post (a vertical stroke down the middle), a back-slash (a diagonal stroke from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner) and a fore-slash (a diagonal stroke from the top-right corner to the bottom-left corner). The green-framed panel on the right is the plan: a grid of 4 rows and 4 columns of coloured squares, each square printed in one of the four legend colours. Build a board by replacing every plan square with the stroke that the legend pairs with that square's colour, keeping the plan's row and column positions, so the board is 4 rows by 4 columns of strokes. The board agrees with one of these five symbols in at least 13 of its 16 tiles. cross: the four tiles running from the top-left corner to the bottom-right corner are back-slashes and the four running from the top-right corner to the bottom-left corner are fore-slashes, so the strokes draw a large X, and the other eight tiles are bars. ladder: every tile of the leftmost column and of the rightmost column is a post and the eight tiles between them are bars, so the strokes draw two tall rails with rungs between them. pillar: every tile of the two middle columns is a post and the eight tiles of the outer columns are bars, so the strokes draw one broad upright column down the centre. chevron: the top row and the bottom row are all bars; in the second row the first tile is a back-slash and the fourth is a fore-slash, and in the third row the second tile is a back-slash and the third is a fore-slash, so the strokes draw a shallow V pointing down at the centre; the remaining tiles are bars. zigzag: the first and third rows have back-slashes in their two left tiles, the second and fourth rows have fore-slashes in their two right tiles, and the other eight tiles are bars, so the lean alternates from row to row. Which of the five symbols does the board match in the most tiles? Answer with one word.
